senses.gloss: m. (Pers. durd, cmp., however, דרד) sediment, lees, dregs.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 32a:1">Ab. Zar. 32ᵃ</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="D00360"><he>דּוּרְדַּיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="D00359"><he>דּוּרְדֵּי</he></cite> (used as sing.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 75:9">Targ. Ps. LXXV, 9</cite>—
<cite ref="Megillah 12b:7">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> like wine resting <he>על דּוּרְדַּיֵּיה</he> upon its lees (<cite ref="Jeremiah 48:11">Jer. XLVIII, 11</cite>).
